title: Headless TTW The American Dream (MQ09): from Raven Rock's holding cell (stage 20) through President Eden's FEV vial and the escape to Elder Lyons and Sarah at the Citadel (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins Finding the Garden of Eden's end (the MQ08 chain's last steps): the player woke in Raven Rock's holding cell and President Eden's intercom talk set MQ09 20 (find a way out). Given here, with the player put in the holding cell (Raven Rock level 3) so this chain runs alone; the gear MQ09's stage-1 script takes off the player is not taken here.

The player wakes in the holding cell by script, not by a walk: the start script (SCPT 0x0A036558 [observed]) runs player.MoveTo MQ09PlayerStartMark; its force field keeps the player in, so walking there from outside could not be done [observed, batch 2026-11-16].
The player's gear in the cell's container: its OnActivate [observed] sets stage 30 (contact) once MQ09 is at 20.
Travel stand-in: Eden's robots lead the player up through Raven Rock to the control room (level 4), where the President speaks from the ZAX unit.

The control room's two guards: each one's death (MQ09ControlRoomGuardScript, OnDeath) adds 1 to MQ09.guarddead, and at 2 MQ09's script unlocks Eden's door 0x0A050C31 (level 100) [observed]. The chain had no fight, so the player found the door locked [observed, batch 2026-11-16].

The FEV panel by the console: stage 40 sets its state 1 [observed]; its script plays the panel open (two animations), then the player's activation gives the FEV vial and starts Project Impurity (MQA 10). Eden's script [observed] sets 50 once the player holds the vial.
Travel stand-in: out of Raven Rock to the landing outside; walking out of the exterior trigger [observed] sets stage 60 (return to the Citadel).

actions.label: milestone: MQ09 60, back to the Citadel

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to Elder Lyons at the Citadel (stage 60 puts him by Liberty Prime). The player tells him the President let them go and hands over the vial (MQA 200).
Lyons' StartConv2 [observed] starts his talk with Sarah (MQ11ElderSarahConv SayTo lines); she then turns to the player.

Sarah briefs the player for the assault on Project Purity; asking for more time ends MQ09 [observed] (stage 200, and Take it Back! stage 20). Saying 'ready' instead sets MQ11 25 and leaves MQ09 to be ended by Liberty Prime's start (MQ11's script).

actions.label: sarah: my father and I have been talking
